title: 多个 GitHub Actions 写入同一分支时采用 fetch/rebase/push 重试，而不是单次 pull 后假设远端不再移动
summary: 多个独立自动化会同时生成报告、索引、Intake 或视觉基线。即使每个 workflow 在 push 前执行一次 pull --rebase，远端仍可能在 rebase 与 push 之间前进。写入器应把‘远端移动’视为可重试的乐观并发冲突：重新 fetch/rebase 后再 push；真正的内容冲突则失败并显式暴露。
principles: A successful pre-push rebase does not lock the remote ref.
Non-fast-forward caused by an intervening disjoint writer is retryable.
Content/rebase conflicts are not silently auto-resolved.
Repository writers share one tested retry helper instead of copy-pasted ad-hoc shell.
Do not serialize every writer with a global concurrency group when dropping/replacing pending work would be unacceptable.
Derived artifacts that conflict after rebase should be regenerated from the latest source state rather than conflict-merged as if they were authored truth.
Persist source evidence before rebuilding dependent derived indexes when the two are independently reproducible.
